meta.description: Separation Program Numbers (SPN) decode database for DD-214 analysis

JFX.narrative: Discharged due to a diagnosed personality disorder that interfered with duty.

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: The VA often conflates 'Personality Disorder' with PTSD or TBI. If you have combat badges or TBI markers, this discharge code is a prime target for a challenge.

suggested_actions.action: Search STRs for 'concussion', 'blast exposure', or 'insomnia' pre-dating this diagnosis

JEA.narrative: Released prior to expiration of term of service to attend an educational institution.

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: Generally benign. Ensure service dates in 'Time Machine' match the shortened service period to calculate accurate effective dates.

GFC.narrative: Discharged for a medical condition that did not meet the definition of a disability for retirement purposes.

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: This code admits a medical condition existed but claims it wasn't 'disabling.' This is a classic starting point for a Service Connection claim.

suggested_actions.action: Draft statement arguing condition has worsened since discharge
Check if this condition causes other ratable issues

KKA.narrative: Discharge related to drug use, often resulting in OTH (Other Than Honorable) characterization.

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: Drug abuse is frequently a symptom of untreated PTSD (self-medication). 'Willful Misconduct' bars benefits, but proving the mental health root cause can overturn this.

suggested_actions.action: Gather buddy statements confirming behavior changes after trauma events

MBK.description: Completion of Active Duty Service Requirement

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: Clean discharge. Focus entirely on medical evidence.

JHJ.narrative: Separated due to a physical disability that qualified for severance pay but not retirement.

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: This confirms a service-connected disability existed. Check if the condition has worsened since discharge or caused secondary conditions.

suggested_actions.action: Argue for increased rating due to progression
Identify secondary conditions stemming from original disability

JFR.narrative: Discharged under pre-DADT policies. May qualify for discharge upgrade under current law.

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: This discharge is now widely recognized as discriminatory. Veterans with this code may be eligible for discharge upgrade and back pay of benefits.

suggested_actions.action: Initiate discharge upgrade under modern DoD review boards

KFS.narrative: Separated for failure to maintain body composition standards.

strategic_implications.red_team_flag: Weight gain can be a symptom of mental health conditions, thyroid disorders, or medication side effects. Check service medical records for underlying causes.

suggested_actions.action: Search for depression, hypothyroidism, or medication changes in STRs
